div.head: Hn Lond 8
div.ab: Et amplius non sit meskenninge in hustinge neque in folkesimote neque in aliis placitis infra civitatem.
And further there shall be no "miskenning" in a husting or a public meeting or in any other courts inside the city.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 290–291 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
